ball-intro.line1: That game that day... it was incredible.
ball-intro.line2: I feel like I'm forgetting how a swing feels…

frame-photo.line1: This is from the youth baseball tournament, the day I placed.

frame-photo-echo.line1: …Their faces. I can finally see them properly.
frame-photo-echo.line2: When I find them, I'll start with this photo.

console-echo.line1: When I get out, we're playing a round.

ball.title: Catch, Alone
ball.phase1: Throw it at the wall and it comes back. That is all. I keep forgetting there is no one to catch it.

calendar.title: October 19
calendar.phase1: The numbers stopped on that day. After that I stopped writing dates and only made tally marks.

phone.title: The Silence
phone.phase1: The group chat has been quiet since that day. Every missed call is one I made.

window.title: Outside
window.phase1: I opened the curtain. Broken glass, a crushed car, stains that will not wash off. I closed it again.

frame.title: Them
frame.phase1: Dust on the glass hides their faces. Even wiped clean, only the two of them stay blurred.

radio.title: That Broadcast
radio.phase1: They said it had reached Busan. I cannot pretend not to know anymore.
radio.phase2: A human voice came through the noise. “Hey, is anyone there?” I am not the only one.

console.title: Not fun anymore
console.phase1: Alone, winning and losing feel the same.
console.phase2: Maybe it gets fun again with two.
